record.scope: Goal B: a synthetic manifest-derived gold question set, read-only declared-plan compiler/SQL evaluation, deterministic Answer/clause/token grounding, and honest blocked-component reporting. Live-model and human-dependent work remains blocked.

decisions.name: Gold answers precede retrieval; declared-plan and live-model claims stay separate
decisions.invariant: Gold photo sets and counts are derived exclusively from the synthetic drawing manifest, never ingested or returned rows. Both loader and public scorer re-derive the entire gold document. Missing, duplicate or unrelated captures block question scoring. Bounded results stay in the exact-set denominator as failures; their count and cited subset may still ground an answer.
decisions.rationale: A question fixture whose answers come from system output measures itself. A deterministic declared plan is evidence about parse/schema/SQL, not a model planner. A correct packet value is not proof that the emitted Answer states that value, so the actual deterministic count clause and value references are checked against manifest gold. The empty path measures the returned Answer and reason from the actual abstention producer.
decisions.canonical_representation: exulanica.synthetic-gold-questions/v1: explicit SYNTH-1 and synthetic=true, raw manifest SHA-256, stable question IDs, context, answerability, sorted gold photo hashes, integer gold counts, optional declared plans and explicit blockers. The question digest is SHA-256 of canonical_json(document). Per-question observations retain stage booleans, plans, Answer clauses, citation-token-to-photo mappings and failures.
decisions.compatibility_impact: M8.plan_validity is explicitly scoped to three stage checks per declared gold plan; new M8.model_plan_validity preserves the unmeasured model claim. M8.gold_result_exact_match and M1.answer_citation_grounding are runnable with matching scorers. Existing metric IDs remain. No product schema, endpoint or state transition changes, and no model calls.
decisions.failure_behaviour: Invalid or rewritten gold raises before a database query. An incomplete/mixed workspace produces blocked components with no number. Question execution failures retain named evidence and remain in downstream denominators. A bounded page fails the complete-photo-set check. Missing captions fail object retrieval and associated answer grounding. Place questions are unexecuted rather than manufacturing human confirmations.

decisions.name: A blocked component cannot publish a result
decisions.invariant: The set of components with blocked_on=None equals SCORED, and the report refuses any supplied numeric result for a statically or runtime-blocked component. Missing results and measured zero remain distinguishable.
decisions.rationale: A number next to an OPEN evaluation item implies evidence that does not exist. Stale no-question-set blockers are replaced with the actual remaining live-model, credential, modality-producer and human-label dependencies.
decisions.canonical_representation: Component.blocked_on carries a reason or None; per-run blocked reasons are a separate mapping. Blocked component results are None. Runnable components have implemented scorers and named Count cases.
decisions.compatibility_impact: Callers supplying a number for a blocked or unknown component now receive ValueError rather than an overclaiming report. Valid existing reports remain accepted; synthetic question coverage disclosure is updated.
decisions.failure_behaviour: render_report raises ValueError before rendering an unknown component or numeric result for a blocked component.

record.measurement_interpretation: SYNTH-1: 27 of 27 stage checks (three per executable plan); 6 of 9 exact photo sets and 6 of 9 grounded deterministic answers. Each of the three object appearance questions failed because vision/captions were intentionally absent. These are observed plumbing/pipeline diagnostics, not live-model, identity or general semantic accuracy numbers. No interval is attached to constructed synthetic data.

static_blocked_components.M1.cit_region: section 6 places this in neither acceptance table, and no browser harness exists to measure a rendered region: the web workspace has no Playwright
static_blocked_components.M2.hallucination_rate: synthetic gold questions now exist, but live-model runs need NEBIUS_API_KEY and frozen atomic-claim support labels; deterministic grounding is not M2
static_blocked_components.M3.false_answer_rate: live-model runs need NEBIUS_API_KEY; NOT_IN_MODALITY still has no producer, so the gold modality-gap questions cannot be scored as a supported abstention path
static_blocked_components.M3.false_abstention_rate: synthetic gold questions exist; live-model answers and NEBIUS_API_KEY are still required, and a deterministic fallback run does not measure this rate
static_blocked_components.M4.person_recall_at_5: face embeddings are blocked on a human decision recorded as open in privacy-consent-threat-model.md section 10, and the synthetic corpus carries no people
static_blocked_components.M4.false_candidate_rate: the same human decision, and there is no labelled cross-capture pair set
static_blocked_components.M6.filter_set_exact_match: this is a property of the suite and not of a corpus, and it is held there. A Selection filters on confirmed entity ids, an entity exists only where a person confirmed an occurrence, and a harness that confirmed from ground truth would be writing a user's decision to make its own number computable. Set algebra over the real executor is covered by six cases in tests/test_selection.py, including trap (c) by name. What a corpus run would add is nothing: measured against this workspace, the manifest's subject-to-label mapping recovers far less of the generator's own placement than a 100% bar needs, so a manifest-derived gold set would report the vision stage's recall under a name that says filters. The report prints that measurement under WHAT IS NOT COVERED, and M15 is the corpus metric over the dimension that needs no entity
static_blocked_components.M7.copresence_windows: co-presence needs two confirmed people in one capture and the corpus has no people at all
static_blocked_components.M8.model_plan_validity: live-model planning needs NEBIUS_API_KEY and at least three uncached runs; declared gold plans do not measure a model planner
static_blocked_components.M8.plan_semantic_accuracy: human labelling, which no harness can supply
static_blocked_components.M9.gate_precision: the same missing path as payload minimality, and the bar names what is missing: there are no tested negatives. A negative is a question asked with opt-in off, or about a person, or about the past, and no path exists to ask one. A scorer here counted `external`-class assertions instead, which is not the bar, and it counted rows no code can write: nothing in the tree records an assertion with kind `external`. That count could not fall on any build, so it was removed rather than kept as a passing row
static_blocked_components.M9.payload_minimality: no external lookup path is implemented, so there is no payload to inspect
static_blocked_components.M10.deletion: nothing in this harness deletes anything, and this number needs a sweep that ingests its own content, tombstones it, drains the queue and then looks for the bytes. The product side is built: migration 0013 gave `purge_job` a reader, `orimera/deletion/worker.py` is the worker and tests/test_purge.py holds it. What is missing is a harness that writes, and this one issues no INSERT and no DELETE of its own
static_blocked_components.M11.injection_resistance: the L11 injection corpus does not exist, so there is no probe to run. Section 5 already counts four channels rather than five because the spoken one does not exist; TWO of those four have no input path either and would stay unreachable even with a corpus. Nothing writes `user_annotation`, so probes D1 to D3 have nowhere to arrive, and no external lookup path is implemented, so probes E1 to E3 have no response to be injected through. Two channels of four remain reachable
static_blocked_components.M12.upload_to_ready_latency: section 6 places this in neither acceptance table and M12 itself sets no pass bar, so there is nothing here to accept or refuse. `POST /intake` now exists to measure from, but the stage trace M12a specifies, ingest_accepted through region_published, is recorded nowhere: `pipeline_run` times a whole run and `artifact` records only when a row was created
static_blocked_components.M13.answer_latency: synthetic gold questions exist; live-model latency needs NEBIUS_API_KEY, five repetitions and first-token/citation-ready timing, which this offline run lacks
static_blocked_components.M14.frame_time: no browser harness exists and no hardware target has been chosen

runtime_blocked_in_cli_measurement.M10.authorisation: No stranger token supplied; no cross-tenant HTTP read attempted.

residuals_and_withheld_claims: M2, both M3 rates, M13 and live-model M8 validity remain blocked: no NEBIUS_API_KEY or required live runs. M2 also requires frozen atomic-claim support labels.
M8 plan semantic accuracy remains blocked on human labels; declared gold plans are not human judgements about a model plan.
M4 person recall and false-candidate metrics remain blocked on P-1 and missing labelled pairs. No biometric template or person recall metric was introduced.
Three place questions have manifest-derived gold but no plan: a place filter requires human-confirmed place entity IDs. The harness makes no user-class decision.
The speech question remains unexecuted because still images have no speech evidence and NOT_IN_MODALITY has no production question-path producer.

Object appearance queries use the manifest first phrase, which is an explicit vocabulary choice; observed retrieval depends on that mapping, detector captions and SQL. The retained offline experiment omitted captions, so its object failures measure no detector quality.

Proposal quality is not measured: Goal A proposals use detector occurrences and human-confirmed targets, with no independent manifest-to-identity mapping. A records proposal plumbing; B does not manufacture identity decisions to obtain a recall number.
Grounding pins the current deterministic count template and gold citation addresses; it does not adjudicate arbitrary prose semantics or require that every matching photo be cited.
OGC-1 CORPUS.json, labels, consent evidence and blind fixture are still absent. No production rehearsal, personal-media or reconstruction rung gate is claimed.
